decision: Plan D is read-only rendering of the already-built layers (coverage banner + intent/diff two-layer + freshness). No new extractors, no data-model change, no action channel.
rationale: The reconciler data exists and is merged; the only gap is that it's invisible. Render it honestly before adding more capability.

decision: Operator annotation/correction (gap #6 from the reconciler contract) is DEFERRED to a Plan D2 follow-up — it needs a persistence sidecar and is a distinct capability from rendering.
rationale: Keep Plan D bounded to the render gap; annotation is its own slice.

decision: Render-truth carries to the UI: a low/medium confidence ceiling renders as explicit incompleteness; intent claims are visibly 'declared', never shown as as-built fact; empty intent reads 'no ADRs found'. Tested through the real shell, not a synthetic mount (per the 2026-06-08 audit B2#1/#3 lesson).
rationale: The audit caught dead-code/synthetic-surface tests; Plan D's journey must enter the real render path.

decision: RECONTRACT to the shipped C0 output (operator sequence 2026-06-10): Plan D acceptance now pins the real producer fields — coverage.baseline (rollup lattice limited/partial/covered, per_language covered/missing_extractor, per_evidence_type over the 10 pinned EVIDENCE_TYPES with tiers incl. reserved runtime, scan_truncated, notes verbatim, unrecognized_extensions), the contract coverage block (confidence_ceiling, extractors incl. adr_intent_extractor, missing_extractors), the 7-value DIFF_TAXONOMY (3 live), and the low-confidence graph items (heuristic_import edges inferred/unresolved, heuristic_target + fs_* nodes). Features restructured F001-F006.
rationale: The original draft predates C0; locking it would have built UI against a stale contract. Step 1 of the operator sequence read architecture_baseline.build_baseline() and both build_view_state branches before editing.

decision: F005 is a BOUNDED exception to D001's read-only-rendering rule: build_view_state's present-architecture branch already computes the C0 baseline but drops its coverage block; F005 attaches it as coverage["baseline"] (mirroring the absent branch) with a parity test. No detector, marker-table, registry, or coverage-rule change.
rationale: Without parity the primary repo (architecture.json present) renders a WEAKER coverage story than an arbitrary repo — the asymmetry was found while reading the contract (architecture_view_state.py attaches baseline coverage only on the absent branch). Exposing already-computed data is render-truth wiring, not a model change.

decision: plan.md frontmatter reset from status:active to status:draft. The plan was drafted as active in PR #30 without ever passing the lock gate (no cleared gates, no sufficiency findings); sufficiency_gate.lock refuses non-draft plans.
rationale: Same defect class as the synthetic-plan status-reset gotcha — a plan that never locked must not present as locked. Reset lets Plan D enter the repaired gate honestly.

decision: Plan D PAUSED pre-lock. Worktree Isolation v0 (docs/plans/2026-06-10-002) jumps the queue per operator direction 2026-06-10: shared-worktree friction (long-lived branches, plan drafts on different bases, stale stashes, untracked Finder duplicates, merge/close rituals, multiple sessions on one repo state) is exactly the risk profile of Plan D + 008 + Plan B + C+ overlapping. Plan D resumes (lock through the repaired gate, then build) after worktree v0 lands.
rationale: Operator: a platform primitive, not polish — reduce operational risk before the overlapping UI/state/test work starts.

decision: Round-1 sufficiency findings (first lock attempt under the new plan worktree, run from inside it — F002 binding snapshot captured live) resolved: (1) HIGH F005 parity upgraded from key-identical to VALUE-IDENTICAL deep equality of the full coverage.baseline block; (2) HIGH F006 absent-architecture journey now asserts the full honesty surface (coverage banner from the absent-branch block, incompleteness wording, architecture_missing warning, no raw JSON) matching the present branch; (3) MED no_adrs state gets its own real-shell journey (honest empty declared-intent + F002 badge fallback); (4) MED architecture_missing warning is now OWNED by F003 with the producer payload field asserted by name and a pinned render location.
rationale: All four were real pins on the recontracted draft; fixed offline in one pass per the paid-gate cadence, one re-lock follows.

decision: Round-2 findings (100% clearance of round 1; 1 high plan_contract + 1 high matrix_pin + 1 med matrix_pin, all journey-depth pins on F006) resolved: (1) both journeys assert F004's confidence legend + styling hooks BY SELECTOR so shell/router regressions fail the journey, not just the narrow render test; (2) the present-branch journey asserts the baseline panel at ROW detail (per_language status, complete 10-row evidence-type table incl. reserved/runtime tier, honest scan_truncated, verbatim notes) driven by the real producer fixture; (3) reserved DIFF_TAXONOMY fallback moved to where it can actually be exercised — F002 renderer-unit test with synthetic reserved values — and the no-ADR journey now asserts NO badges render (the producer never emits reserved values, so a journey cannot prove fallback).
